_doc: A4-owned registry of superseded rows, used IN ADDITION to run_meta (authoritative: run_meta.p2g_rule, run_meta.annotations.p2g_rule, run_meta.annotations.superseded_conds written by A2). load.py drops matching rows BEFORE any table or NUMBERS key is computed; they go to out/<mode>/superseded_rows.csv for audit only. Handbook IE_P2G rows must have a known P2G rule; unknown -> SchemaDriftError. Entries: run_id, conds (or ['*']), optional models, p2g_rule, reason.
